page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-1xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated graphics acceleration and substantial system memory. Running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 CPU architecture, this server features 20 shared vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.8 GB per vCPU. The instance includes a single NVIDIA L4 GPU from the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM.

This configuration does not include local storage, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. It comes with one complimentary public IPv4 address. A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may introduce resource contention under sustained, high-intensity CPU workloads. However, the high system memory capacity and dedicated GPU VRAM mitigate resource bottlenecks for memory-intensive operations.

The combination of an NVIDIA L4 GPU and 256.0 GB of RAM makes this server suitable for machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and moderately demanding graphics rendering tasks. It is also well-suited for memory-intensive database hosting and analytical processing workloads that benefit from GPU acceleration but do not require dedicated, non-shared CPU cores.
